**Verdict:** Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The added block is byte-for-byte what the generator writes: the `START` / `**Example cases**` / `No catalog case yet.` / `END` shape at `xtask/src/catalog_links.rs:158-165`.
- The block sits directly under the `## Slot Undercut` heading and before the icon line, like every sibling section (for example "2D Offset", `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:272-278`).
- "Slot Undercut" is a registered kind (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs:2462`), so the committed check requires its block. That is the exact gap that made `catalog_seed_links_face_pocket_and_drill` red on main (#3256).

## Results

- Not built. The diff changes one markdown file under `site/`. No crate code changed, so no test binary and no clippy arm maps to it. This is a read-only review by design.
- The author ran `cargo test -p xtask catalog_` on this head and reports 14 + 5 tests pass (PR body). This review verified the same check statically: block format, heading registry entry, and placement.
- Mergeable with main: GitHub reports MERGEABLE. No trial merge was needed for a content-only diff.

## Heavy lanes

- The diff reaches no heavy lane.

## Law and process checks

- Body: `Changelog: none` present, ends with `Fixes #3256`. Commit subject is conventional: `fix(docs): ...`.
- No process files touched (`xtask/`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `.cargo/`, `build.rs`, `Cargo.toml`): no `Process change` line needed.
- No `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no golden change, no snapshot PNG change.
- Clean-room: the guide text is our own.

## Requested before merge

- None.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
